comments: Elegant cross-kingdom mimicry strategy, but functional validation relied primarily on genetic analysis rather than direct biochemical interaction measurements.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Nematode RGF peptides functionally mimic plant endogenous RGFs via RGI-receptor pathway
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; MgRGF and MiRGF1 activate host RGF signaling and promote feeding cell identity

hypotheses.hypothesis: PSY genes are downstream effectors of RGF signaling in rice parasitism
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; OsPSY5 positively regulates cell elongation and facilitates nematode parasitism

title: Mechanisms and functions of large extracellular vesicle biogenesis
task: Review mechanisms and biological contexts of large extracellular vesicle (L-EV) biogenesis and applications
key_results: L-EVs identified as distinct subsets with roles in cellular content removal and intercellular communication; potential as biomarkers and therapeutic delivery vehicles
comments: Comprehensive review rather than experimental work; field lacks standardized characterization methods for diverse L-EV subtypes.

title: Task offloading and resource allocation for cooperative communication and sensing in edge computing for mine
task: Task offloading and resource allocation in edge computing for mining
key_results: IGWO-FCA achieves lowest Overall Utility Value (OUV) balancing system delay and energy consumption
Optimized task allocation and wireless bandwidth ratios reduce both system latency and energy consumption
comments: The paper addresses a practical industrial problem but lacks comparison with other metaheuristic baselines and provides only simulation validation without real edge deployment results.

model_io.model: Improved Gray Wolf Optimization with Feasibility Checking Algorithm (IGWO-FCA)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cooperative communication and sensing with environmental awareness improves task allocation over centralized approaches
hypotheses.result: IGWO-FCA validated through simulation to minimize OUV metric

hypotheses.hypothesis: Feasibility checking integrated into optimization reduces assignment to unstable edge servers
hypotheses.result: Framework prevents heavy upload traffic congestion in suboptimal servers

title: Extreme lensing signatures revealed by correlations of simulated black hole movies
task: Detect extreme gravitational lensing signatures in black hole images via correlation analysis
key_results: Two-point image correlation function reveals lensing signatures invisible in time-averaged images and autocorrelations at next-generation VLBI resolution
comments: Promising method for probing relativistic strong-field gravity, but requires careful instrument specifications and inference techniques still to be developed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Two-point image correlations encode extreme lensing signatures not visible in intensity images
hypotheses.result: Signatures clearly visible in correlation function at VLBI resolution

title: Cavity quantum electrodynamics control of quantum Hall stripes
task: Control quantum Hall stripes using cavity quantum electrodynamics
key_results: Cavity-induced suppression of longitudinal resistivity below zero-field value; stabilization of quantum Hall stripes between quantized plateaus at ultralow temperature
comments: Novel demonstration of cavity-QED control of correlated phases, though the precise mechanism coupling vacuum fluctuations to stripe order merits deeper investigation.

model_io.model: High-mobility 2D electron system in engineered cavity and strong magnetic field

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cavity vacuum fluctuations can stabilize thermally disordered quantum Hall stripes
hypotheses.result: Observed suppression of longitudinal resistivity and stripe stabilization between plateaus

title: Spatially anisotropic Kondo resonance coupled with the superconducting gap in a kagome metal
task: Reveal interplay of Kondo resonance and superconductivity in doped kagome metal
key_results: Spatially anisotropic Kondo resonance with ripple-like patterns breaks local mirror symmetry; superconducting coherence peak and gap depth enhanced with Kondo screening; Cr doping weakens charge density wave
comments: Spatially-resolved STM imaging elegantly maps local magnetic and superconducting interactions, though the origin of anisotropic Kondo patterns and their role in pairing enhancement deserve further investigation.

model_io.model: Cr-doped kagome superconductor CsV3Sb5 (scanning tunneling microscopy)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Magnetic Cr impurities induce Kondo resonances that couple to superconductivity
hypotheses.result: Anisotropic Kondo patterns and enhanced coherence peak observed

hypotheses.hypothesis: Kondo screening of Cr moments increases superfluid density through carrier participation
hypotheses.result: Enhanced gap depth and finite zero-energy conductance with Kondo emergence

title: Controllable hydro-thermoelastic heat transport in ultrathin semiconductors at room temperature
task: Control non-diffusive heat transport via hydro-thermoelastic coupling in 2D semiconductors
key_results: Demonstrated reduction in effective thermal diffusivity through combined hydrodynamic and thermoelastic effects; thermoelastic heat flux from cold to hot regions; controllable via thickness and heating mode at room temperature
comments: First experimental observation of intertwined hydro-thermoelastic transport with nanoscale resolution; counterintuitive reverse heat flux warrants careful validation and mechanistic studies.

model_io.model: Hydro-thermoelastic heat transport model in 2D semiconductors (MoSe2, MoS2)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hydrodynamic and thermoelastic effects jointly reduce thermal diffusivity in ultrathin semiconductors
hypotheses.result: Non-diffusive regime observed with controllable reduction via thickness and heating control

hypotheses.hypothesis: Strain-induced thermoelastic effects can generate heat flux opposing temperature gradient
hypotheses.result: Observed counterintuitive thermoelastic contribution from cold to hot regions

title: Relative benefits of different active learning methods to conceptual physics learning
task: Compare conceptual learning outcomes across active learning methods in physics
key_results: All four methods improved conceptual learning; SCALE-UP showed significantly larger gains than Peer Instruction or ISLE; student peer networks similar across methods
comments: Multi-institutional study identifies classroom activity structure (student-centered vs. lecture-heavy) as likely driver, but causal mechanisms remain to be established.

model_io.model: Four active learning pedagogies: Peer Instruction, ISLE, Tutorials, SCALE-UP

hypotheses.hypothesis: Active learning methods increase conceptual understanding relative to traditional lecturing
Amount of in-class student-centered activity correlates with learning gains
hypotheses.result: Suggestive evidence; SCALE-UP and Tutorials showed more activity and larger gains

title: Super-resolving frequency measurement with mode-selective quantum memory
task: Super-resolved optical frequency measurement using quantum memory
key_results: 34±4-fold precision enhancement over direct measurements; sensitivity of 1/20 linewidth; mode crosstalk as low as 0.34%
comments: Clever use of mode-selective Raman memory to beat the spectroscopic diffraction limit, though scalability to multiple spectral features remains unclear.

model_io.model: Mode-selective atomic Raman quantum memory in warm caesium vapour

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mode-selective storage can suppress crosstalk while preserving spectral resolution
